decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 01, 02, 20 and design and access statement. Received: 6th February 2017
Sk02 Rev C. 13th March 2017 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The cycle parking shown on drawing number sk02 revision C shall be in the form of Sheffield stands, made available for use before the library use hereby approved is first opened to the public, and retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 4 - The library use hereby approved shall not be used outside of the following times, 9.30am- 5.30pm Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, 9.30am- 8pm Tuesday and Thursday and 11.30am- 4pm Sundays excluding public holidays.
Condition : 5 - The adult education classrooms hereby approved shall not be used outside of the following times,  9am-5pm Monday to Friday excluding public holidays.
description: Change of use in the Lampton Park Conference Centre (1040 m2) into Use Class D1 (Non-residential Institutions) - Lending Library. The change of use of a 304 m2 area of the ground floor of the Civic Centre into Use Class D1 (Non-residential Institutions) - Adult Education Classrooms.
